name: Plundering the Plunderers
summary: Wrenix the Wretched sends new Shattered Hand rogues against the Southsea Freebooters near Ratchet. Aboard the Tide Razor, they face pirates, locked strongboxes, and a dangerous guardian before claiming the Southsea Treasure.

sections.title: A Test of Stealth and Steel
sections.body: Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin contact in Ratchet, tests aspiring Shattered Hand operatives. He sends rogues south along the Barrens coast to a cove where the Tide Razor lies at anchor, crewed by Southsea Freebooters. They must board without being seen, enter the pirates’ den where cutpurses train, pick the strongboxes in the hold, and bring back the plunder.

sections.title: Polly and the Gizmo
sections.body: Wrenix warns that earlier thieves were returned to him in pieces. A savage parrot named Polly guards the vessel’s lowest hold. To help a rogue face the bird, Wrenix provides an experimental E.C.A.C. Hurl it at Polly after cracking the pirate strongbox; the device disorients and weakens the bird, making the fight winnable.

faq.answer: Wrenix the Wretched is a goblin rogue contact in Ratchet. He works with operatives linked to Orgrimmar’s Shattered Hand, sending new thieves into pirate territory to practice lockpicking and recover stolen plunder.

faq.q: Where is the Tide Razor located?
faq.answer: The Tide Razor is anchored south of Ratchet along the Barrens’ eastern coast, in a Southsea Freebooter cove. The ship is a base and training den for the pirates.

faq.q: What is an E.C.A.C. and how do I use it?
faq.answer: The E.C.A.C. is an experimental goblin device dispensed by Wrenix’s Gizmotronic Apparatus. Use it against Polly, the giant parrot guarding the Southsea Treasure in the Tide Razor’s hold, to weaken the bird so it can be defeated.

faq.q: Why is the lockpicking area on the ship significant?
faq.answer: The Tide Razor’s second deck is the Southsea pirates’ training room. Its lockboxes let rogues practice lockpicking in the field before they try the strongbox below.

faq.q: Why is this mission so vital for rogues?
faq.answer: Completing the heist proves a rogue’s worth to the Shattered Hand network. Wrenix gives you Thistle Tea as your share, a brew that quickly restores a rogue’s combat energy.
Polly is a vicious parrot guarding the lower hold of the Tide Razor for the Southsea Freebooters. Without goblin technology to weaken the bird, it is lethal to inexperienced infiltrators.

angles.text: As a rogue, you learn to pick locks under pressure and receive Thistle Tea, a prized brew for operatives serving the Horde.
As a rogue with an interest in cooking, you can earn Thistle Tea, an herbal tonic valued for restoring energy.
The Shattered Hand uses goblin contacts in Ratchet to test prospective agents against the Southsea Freebooters, who menace the Barrens coast.
